name: Alex S. Bakken
prior_offices: Carbon County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Alex S. Bakken is the Carbon County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official sheriff page lists him in that office. The Rawlins Times reported that he was among the county officials who won at the polls.

sources.name: Rawlins Times, Nov. 4, 2026, Carbon County sees no real surprises in 2026 midterm elections
